myListings.title: My listings
myListings.visibility: Only approved listings appear in search. Drafts, pending and rejected listings are visible to you only.
myListings.emptyFilter: You have no listings with this status.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this listing?
deleteDialog.description: Its photos, videos and inspections are deleted too. You can't undo this.

newListing.title: Describe your listing
newListing.description: Buyers see this title and description on your listing.

tips.title: Put the make, model and version in the title
tips.description: Mention maintenance history and number of keys

carDetails.title: Car details
carDetails.description: These fields power search filters and the inspection checklist.
carDetails.conditionHelper: Be honest, the inspector will grade it too.

tips.mileage: Exact mileage: inspectors check it against the dashboard and service history
tips.fiscalPower: Fiscal power (CV) as shown on the carte grise
tips.history: Mention maintenance history and number of keys in the description

equipment.title: Equipment
equipment.description: Optional. Buyers filter by equipment, so tick only what the car really has.

photos.title: Photos & videos
photos.description: At least 3 photos, up to 20 files with videos. The cover is shown first in search and must be a photo.
photos.formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP up to 10 MB · videos MP4 up to 50 MB
photos.storageNote: Photos upload straight to secure storage. Hide your number plate and carte grise numbers: the inspector checks them in person.

tips.angles: Front and rear three-quarter views, in daylight
tips.interior: The interior, and the dashboard showing the mileage
tips.engine: The engine bay and the tyres

problems.title: Some files were not added
problems.type: {{name}}: only JPG, PNG, WEBP and MP4 files are accepted.
problems.size: {{name}}: too large. Photos can be up to 10 MB, videos up to 50 MB.
problems.limit: {{name}}: a listing holds up to 20 files.
problems.rejected: {{name}}: refused because of its type or size.

review.title: Review and submit
review.description: Check everything before you send it. Our team reviews every listing before it appears in search.
review.note: Our team checks every listing, usually in under 24 hours.

submitted.title: Submitted for review
submitted.description: Our team checks every listing, usually in under 24 hours. It appears in search once approved.
